title: Cluj Napoca repeat as Liga Nationala champions
description: Cluj Napoca - Oradea 97-89 Cluj Napoca earned the fourth straight Liga Nationala title. They outscored Oradea in the fifth game of the Finals to defend their title. Cluj Napoca led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They made 24-of-31 free shots (77.4 percent) during the game. 26 personal fouls committed by Oradea helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was American point guard Bryce Jones (183-1994, college: Murray St.) who scored 22 points. The former international point guard Patrick Richard (193-1990, college: McNeese St., agency: Inception Sports) chipped in 10 points, 5 rebounds and 8 assists.
